Include mechanisms, explanations, qualifications and applications, even when they directly answer the question. A later separate review decides which claims are correct and novel against the graph; do not filter for either here. Do not grade, improve the answer, or invent facts. Return claims=[] only if the student makes no factual assertion in target_passage. The question and answer_context are ONLY for resolving references. Claims about other concepts must also be extracted. Preserve qualifications, negation and actors. Each candidate is one directed relationship. Reuse supplied concept names where appropriate; leave existing_id null. New endpoints require clear definitions.
